convert_colpali_weights_to_hf: convert ColPali model weights from the original repository to HuggingFace format
rename_state_dict_keys: rename state dict keys from original ColPali format to HuggingFace transformers format
load_original_state_dict: load original ColPali state dict from safetensors files on the HuggingFace Hub
